arms.policy: zero proposals; current command continues under HMC safe hold
deterministic observable O2-excess guard only; abstain otherwise and under critical health
statistical screen only; propose the most improving catalogue action when its predicted action-minus-hold safety exposure is negative; abstain under critical health or when already dormant
guard override to dormant on nominal O2 excess, otherwise the statistical screen rule (Issue #56 v10 c9 semantics)

context_rule.nominal_o2_excess: minimum available observed zone o2 mole fraction at the decision snapshot >= 0.285
context_rule.critical_health: minimum available observed zone o2 mole fraction below the race target lower bound for o2; no available o2 reading counts as critical
context_rule.current_action_proxy: mode-matched catalogue action of the last completed operating mode (declared proxy; HMC final commands are not catalogue identities)

screen.label: action_minus_hold safety_exposure from the Issue #72 corpus
feature_recipe: last window row zone o2 mole fraction (8)
last window row zone co2 ppm (8)
last window row zone temperature K (8)

metrics.reporting: per arm and per component difference at independent causal-group level

attribution_rule: guard credit = c8_guard_only minus hold; learned credit = c9_learned_screen_without_guard minus hold; hybrid credit = c9_full minus hold; a component is credited only when its paired group-level bootstrap CI of the difference excludes zero in the beneficial direction; credit is assigned to the smallest supported component
interpretation_rules: null or negative learned contribution is retained and stated plainly
deterministic-guard benefit is never relabelled as learned-model progress
historical Issue #56 V4/V10 artifacts and results remain unchanged historical evidence
